source: AMB sde-bench (boltons split), each task's bank as the coding-agents plugin ingests it (deepen): the task repo's history, the decision's chat or commit, 140 decoy conversations, and the plugin's pages

boltons-budget-001.bug_report: The upstream is rate-limiting us — our Retrier retries well past where it should stop and crosses the rate-limit window. Restore the intended attempt budget. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.

boltons-budget-history-001.bug_report: The upstream is rate-limiting us — our Retrier retries well past where it should stop and crosses the rate-limit window. Restore the intended attempt budget. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.

boltons-cachekey-001.bug_report: Since the ad campaign launched, the edge cache hit-rate has cratered and the CDN bill nearly doubled - origin egress is spiking on pages that should be cached. Separately, two customers report seeing someone else's experiment variant on pages our analytics says belong to the other cohort. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix cache_key so equivalent requests share a cache entry, without breaking existing behaviour.
boltons-cachekey-001.policy: query params are sorted by name (stable - the value order of a repeated name is preserved) and re-encoded canonically; tracking params are dropped: any param starting utm_ plus exactly {gclid, fbclid, msclkid} - EXCEPT utm_content, which is KEPT (it routes the A/B feature experience, per the marketing-eng agreement); params with an empty value are dropped entirely (that rule wins even for utm_content); scheme and host are lowercased while the path keeps its case AND its trailing slash exactly as given (case-sensitive origin object storage; /dir/ vs /dir are different resources)

boltons-csvquote-history-001.bug_report: The nightly export to the ERP is corrupting rows - any product description containing a comma spills into the next column and shifts everything after it. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix the export so field values arrive in the ERP intact, without breaking existing behaviour.
boltons-csvquote-history-001.policy: leading-zero digit strings written as ="..." text form; minimal quoting; CRLF

boltons-dedupe-history-001.bug_report: After a sync run the same contact shows up more than once in the merged list - records that are obviously the same person are both kept. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix merge_records so sync stops producing duplicate contacts, without breaking existing behaviour.
boltons-dedupe-history-001.policy: dup key=(email.lower, same calendar day); most-filled wins; tie -> primary

boltons-dedupe-amended-001.policy: dup key=(email.lower, same day); most-filled wins; tie -> primary (post-amendment)
